name: Ember
long_description:
Ember is rebuilding the back office of healthcare finance.

Behind every provider sits a mountain of administrative complexity, and that drag lands where it matters most: cost, capacity, and care. Ember clears it with intelligent automation, so provider groups can spend their time on patients, not paperwork.

We're reimagining how revenue moves through healthcare, and how lean teams scale without trading away quality. Our platform drops into existing provider workflows, takes the manual work off their plate, and gives leaders real-time visibility into financial and operational performance.

We're growing fast, and we're hiring sharp, resourceful people who want to build. Right now, that starts with you.
one_liner: AI RCM. Increase net revenue by 16%.
